rows.requirement: A typed application admission boundary remains structurally refusal-only while Stage 17 production evidence is unavailable.
rows.rationale: Schema version 1 has no admitted member, accepts no Stage 17 evidence object, grants no authority, and refuses before injected usage/effect callbacks.

rows.requirement: The direct Anthropic provider boundary enforces the reviewed bounded request, stream, schema, cancellation, substitution and redaction contract.
rows.rationale: Deterministic transport tests prove protocol behavior only; they do not prove a live provider route.

rows.requirement: An explicit body-bounded opt-in live Anthropic canary proves the reviewed real transport without repository or credential disclosure.
rows.rationale: No reviewed real transport/canary harness is present; deterministic fake transport is not live-provider evidence.

rows.requirement: Product planning preserves bounded independent contributions, dissent, scope decisions, approval binding and exact durable replay.
rows.rationale: Planning outputs remain non-authorizing and approved task projections are digest-bound.

rows.requirement: A separately routed completeness audit proves every required and expected-quality product item or authorized waiver.
rows.rationale: The roadmap assigns deterministic completeness evaluation and integration admission to Stage 19; Stage 18 must not claim it.

rows.requirement: The durable runtime proves queues, attempts, leases, fencing, retry, fairness, deadlines, capacity, budgets, usage reconciliation, cancellation and replay.
rows.rationale: The runtime records intent and durable lifecycle only; no live worker executor is wired.

rows.requirement: Independent processes claim different eligible scheduler work under bounded contention with an effect-free retry policy and no duplicate lease; independent PostgreSQL adapters racing distinct work against one shared near-cap borrowed profile allow at most one reservation and preserve the 50/70 percent caps.
rows.rationale: The application retries only effect-free claim-work at most four times; the required hosted job must still prove independent connections and separate Node processes receive distinct leases, while a synchronized two-adapter SERIALIZABLE race must prove shared borrowed-cap write skew fails closed.

rows.requirement: SQLite remains the exact close/reopen single-user Windows desktop persistence composition.
rows.rationale: SQLite creates its explicitly requested file but grants no worker/provider authority.

rows.requirement: The PostgreSQL adapter passes the complete shared persistence and physical application reopen contracts against a real server.
rows.rationale: Source and deterministic seam are locally green; the required exact-head hosted PostgreSQL service run is pending.

rows.requirement: Real PostgreSQL proves concurrent migration startup, independent optimistic writes, native SKIP LOCKED claims, finite lock timeout, sequence identity and redacted failure behavior.
rows.rationale: The hosted disposable PostgreSQL job is the definitive database evidence and has not run at this uncommitted checkpoint.

rows.requirement: Authorized-profile routing enforces exact ownership, freshness, revocation, DST/window identity, 50/70 percent caps, predicted crossing, Fable exclusion and fail-closed scoring.
rows.rationale: Injected usage ports are caller-trusted; their data is strictly normalized and cannot revive an ineligible route.

rows.requirement: The pinned Account Manager investigation and fixture protocol expose no credential/body/UI authority and fail closed on malformed, duplicate, stale, contradictory or mismatched observations.
rows.rationale: The executable injected reader is caller-trusted; the package bundles no installed-state reader.

rows.requirement: A supported read-only live Account Manager integration supplies authorized profile snapshots without UI or credential extraction.
rows.rationale: Only the static investigation and fixture protocol exist; no supported live installed-state reader is bundled or claimed.

rows.requirement: Crash/restart and duplicate delivery prove no duplicate external workspace, Git or provider mutation after ambiguous process failure.
rows.rationale: Durable intent/no-redispatch is proven, but no external-effect executor or effect receipt exists; zero live effects cannot prove mutation idempotency.

rows.requirement: Stage 18D has exact local gates, dependency/audit/package evidence, independent review, explicit-path commits, non-forced publication and exact-head hosted CI including PostgreSQL.
rows.rationale: Exact local gates and final independent PASS are present; checkpoint publication and exact-head hosted results remain pending.

rows.requirement: Production remains unavailable until the private Stage 17 verifier supplies its exact required evidence and later deployment gates pass.
rows.rationale: The separately safety-gated operation remains untouched and absent; no Stage 18 artifact can substitute for it.
